title: IDKMesh Gate Audit Dependence Report v0.1
description: Measured pairwise verifier error-dependence for the exact same verdict matrix a gate-audit-report-v0.1 was computed from (bound by provenance.input_digest_sha256), produced by `idkmesh gate-audit-dependence`. gate-audit-report-v0.1 exposes only the panel mean pairwise error correlation; this artifact exists so a future adaptive verifier-allocation revision can consume each pair's own measured phi correlation instead of reconstructing it from the mean or from provider/family identity. It is decision support only: it grants no routing, acceptance, EvaluatorPlan, or merge authority, and it never aggregates pairs into a per-verifier reputation score.

evidence_class.description: Copied verbatim from the input declaration. A report can never upgrade synthetic fixture data into an observed claim.

verifier_ids.description: Every verifier id from the input, sorted, independent of input list order.

pairs.description: One entry per unordered verifier pair, in the order itertools.combinations(sorted(verifier_ids), 2) produces.

phi_error.description: Pearson correlation of the pair's binary error vectors over non-probe candidates, or null when unmeasurable.

measurable.description: False when either error vector has zero variance; phi_error is then null, never 0 - unmeasurable is not the same claim as independent.

input_digest_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical (sort_keys, compact-separator) verdict-matrix input JSON. Identical to the matching gate-audit-report-v0.1's provenance.input_digest_sha256 for the same input, so the two artifacts can be proven to describe the same audited population.
